The Lighthouse Keeper's Year

For twelve months the keeper wrote down the weather, the ships and the birds, in a ledger that is now kept at the harbour museum.

Every entry starts with the wind. Most of them end with the lamp, lit at dusk and put out at dawn.

From the ledger

Fog until noon. Two gulls on the rail, then none.

  • The weather, twice a day
  • Ships, by name
  • Birds, when there were any
